extra_quotes: First-principles calculations were carried out with the Viennaab initioSimulation Package (V ASP) [22, 23].
Exchange and correlation were treated within the Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof generalized-gradient approximation [24], and the projector-augmented-wave (PA W) method was used [25].
Harmonic force constants were obtained with the finite-displacement method as implemented in Phonopy [27].
